title: OvenRoasted Smoky German Muffin Sandwich
description: A fatty, crumbly post-workout German sandwich with smoked sausage, feta, oats and a smoky kick, baked to golden perfection.
instructions: Brush both sides of English muffin halves with olive oil.
Place the muffins on a baking sheet and bake for 5 minutes until slightly toasted.
While muffins toast, heat a skillet over medium heat and cook sausage slices until browned.
In a small bowl, combine feta, rolled oats, smoked paprika, and oregano.
Remove muffins from oven and spread a thin layer of tomato paste on the bottom halves.
Sprinkle the oat-feta mixture evenly over the tomato paste.
Top with cooked sausage, then place the top muffin halves on top.
Return the assembled sandwiches to the oven for 7 minutes until cheese melts and edges are golden; garnish with parsley before serving.
